title: Chef's Simple Dish
ingredients: Sauce: 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil
Aromatics: 2 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp grated ginger
steps: Prep all ingredients by chopping vegetables and measuring sauces.
Heat vegetable oil in a 30cm skillet over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and ginger, stirring constantly for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add protein and cook until fully browned.
Toss in mixed vegetables and pour sauce mixture over the pan.
Simmer for 5 minutes until sauce thickens and serve hot.
